decisions.question: nidana.model.8's final review: Topic, TopicRef and Lineage keep Object.toString (the Interface declares none), so later phases' test failures print Instance of 'TopicRef'. Add renderings now?

options.label: No; route to the end-of-node sweep as an hsdd-contract question
options.consequence: The declared surface stays the contract's; later phases' tests may print opaque failures until a compatible contract touch adds renderings.

options.label: Add toString overrides now
options.consequence: Changes the declared surface without the contract; D4 gives lib/src/topic/ no later owner to keep it consistent.
